recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-layered composition featuring a group of four figures in urban streetwear posed against a geometric, collage-style background. The style is characterized by high-contrast photography, bold primary and secondary colors, and playful, irregular hand-drawn typography that overlaps the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects in dark, textured streetwear contrast against a bright, pastel-geometric background
Hand-drawn typography is clustered in the upper left, creating a heavy visual weight
Large, faded background letters create a secondary layer of depth behind the subjects
A red flower icon acts as a focal point, bridging the text and the background
coreInvariants: Geometric color blocks in yellow, purple, and teal
Urban 90s fashion including leather jackets and bandanas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged diagonally from center-left to right, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cluster of bold, black and colored text in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, follows the diagonal line of the figures' heads down to the bottom right, then circles back through the background shapes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space is used strategically in the center and bottom to separate the dark clothing from the colorful background elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal, Yellow, Purple, and Red (geometric shapes and icons)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in accents against deep blacks and bright whites.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid gradients; use flat, solid color blocks for background elements.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke widths within single characters
Mixing of lowercase and uppercase forms within words
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular 'O' with a heavy black fill
Lowercase 'i' with a large, square dot

composition.overlap: Letters overlap each other and the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking different hand-drawn styles with a single bold accent color.

preserve: The mix of black and teal text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the DIY, collage feel of the 90s
Matches the rough edges and irregular weights

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of four people in 90s urban streetwear (leather jackets, bandanas, sunglasses) against a white background with large, faded purple and yellow geometric shapes and ghosted block letters.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, irregular black and teal lettering in the top left corner, featuring a mix of sizes and a red flower icon, with a thick red underline beneath the main word.

verificationChecks: Is the text layout staggered and overlapping?
Are the background colors flat and geometric?
Does the photography have high contrast and deep blacks?
Is the red flower icon present as a visual bridge?

mustAchieve: Tactile, hand-made quality to the graphics
Strong contrast between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks hand-drawn rather than digitally typed.
Verify the figures are wearing authentic 90s streetwear textures.
Check that the background shapes do not overwhelm the subjects.
Confirm the red underline adds a grounding element to the text block.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast urban photography with a white-base collage background featuring pastel geometric shapes and ghosted letters, topped with irregular, hand-cut black display typography and a single bright floral accent.
